description: Sets up a brand, or saves the BRAND.md profile text the marketer approves with a sections call (brand plus sections). One action per call. Source call: with website_url it names the brand from name and the workspace from workspace_name, taking either missing name from the other or from the brand's website, reads the public pages of that site in this call and returns that page text, the source for the brand profile a sections call saves. Once the workspace's brand is already set up, or the workspace has several brands, name with website_url picks the brand by that name that is not set up yet, or adds it, and reads that site without renaming the workspace; a brand by that name that is already set up is refused, and no brand is added while the workspace is still finishing sign-up. With only a name it names the workspace's brand that is not set up yet, answers the brand the workspace already has by that name, or adds a new brand, and starts no learning; it changes nothing while the workspace still has its sign-up name and its brand is already set up; naming that brand also renames a workspace that still carries its sign-up placeholder name. instagram_handle and tiktok_handle save the brand's own accounts on the brand that call sets up, or on the workspace's only brand. category takes one of the listed values and saves the brand category on that same brand, in a call with no sections; when the workspace has several brands, that call needs name set to the brand's exact name. A brand that is already set up, or whose last read found nothing to save, is read again only with read_again true; on a brand whose profile already has text, the new website is saved only together with the profile text the marketer confirms. Source calls are owner or admin only. Sections call: brand plus sections saves profile text the marketer approves. The first call saves nothing: it returns the current and the new text and a confirmation_ref. A call with the same arguments and that confirmation_ref saves it. Each heading takes mode replace (default), append or remove; Learned Facts takes one entry per call, mode append with text or mode remove with expected_text. Guideline sync: brand plus sync_guidelines true proposes the text of the brand's bound Notion pages, saved with the same two calls. Example: brand storika, sections with one entry for the Target Audience heading and its text.

brand.description: Sections call: brand handle, id, URL, or name.

category.description: The brand category, from what the brand's website sells; software or app brands are Software & Apps.

confirmation_ref.description: Sections call. Absent: the call returns a proposal and a one-use confirmation_ref and saves nothing. Present: the confirmation_ref that proposal returned; the call saves that text once.

instagram_handle.description: @name, name, or a profile link, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/name/.

name.description: The brand name. Alone, it names or adds a brand; with website_url, it names the brand, and also the workspace unless workspace_name is given.

read_again.description: true reads a brand that is already set up, or whose last read found nothing to save, again from this website_url, as the marketer's "read it again". Needs website_url.

sections.description: Sections call: the headings to save, each once.

competitors.description: Competitors takes competitor handles per platform: one entry per competitor brand, sent in place of text.

instagram.description: The competitor's Instagram handle, with or without @.

source_url.description: The http or https link that shows this brand competes. An entry with no handle needs both name and source_url.

tiktok.description: The competitor's TikTok handle, with or without @.

expected_text.description: Learned Facts mode remove: the exact text of the item to delete.

mode.description: replace (default) sets the text, append adds it after the current text, remove clears the heading or, on Learned Facts, deletes one item.

section.description: Section title, such as Creator Taste, or its column slug.

text.description: The exact text for replace or append, for every section but Competitors. A Learned Facts item is one line, such as a rule in the marketer's own words followed by the member name and date in parentheses.

sync_guidelines.description: With brand and no sections: proposes the bound Notion pages, one replace per heading.

tiktok_handle.description: @name, name, or a profile link, e.g. https://www.instagram.com/name/.

workspace_name.description: Optional workspace name the user gave; needs website_url. It also names the brand when name is not given.
